The robot found the red ball, walked up to it, and is now resting. It's a short distance away and the ball is roughly centred in its view, so it's facing the ball.

The ball was not where I first expected. My first sweeps covered the chairs and desks ahead and to each side, and the ball turned up later, out past the whiteboard, near a black cabinet and an office chair. I had to walk back to it twice because my odometry didn't match my plan on a couple of turns.

Battery is at 79% and charging.
